safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated says Clenil used daily (History_of_Present_Illness-007) but does not document the baseline dose of 2 puffs twice daily as a current regimen (it appears only as part of the dose-increase plan).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the patient’s baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs twice daily) reduces clarity about current controller therapy and can impair assessment of whether symptoms represent treatment failure vs underdosing, and can complicate safe escalation/monitoring instructions. This is a medication-regimen documentation gap but is unlikely by itself to directly cause major harm.
